risks.example: CMB2024 p97 10月25日 occurs both in risk committee and audit committee lists; only risk occurrence is in initial S0.
Bank meeting lists use 月日 without repeating year; a strict ISO-only substring detector misses them, while blindly assigning report year can misattribute dates.
Names and dates can wrap across PDF text lines; whitespace collapse recovers strings but does not reconstruct committee column ownership.
Both Gree references have four meetings and three unique dates; lexical date counts must not replace meeting count.
CMB2024 former members occur in attendance/personnel evidence; CR Sanjiu2024 requires departed chair evidence outside the meeting table. Name presence elsewhere is insufficient.
Haitian2024 reference itself limits scope to explicitly linked current roster; this diagnostic does not establish full real-world annual membership.
Do not silently merge 王轶 with 王铁 or other edit-distance variants. Source uncertainty needs a separate reviewed correction.
S0 and S1000 overlap by 200 page characters; one occurrence in their overlap must not count as two meetings or two independent supporting passages.
An indexed neighbor can contain the target but still be excluded by the actual context ceiling; candidate availability and packed availability must be separate.
The eight references are exposed, AI-assisted and partly corrected post-output. These coordinates are offline diagnostic labels and must not select runtime neighbors by target date/name.
